property_summary: For any depositor and any single deposit amount, if the depositor calls withdrawAll (possibly routed through an attacker contract address) the correct contract always leaves the depositor's credit at zero after withdrawAll returns; a re-entrant mutant that performs the external call before zeroing can allow a reentrant attacker to cause the depositor's credit to be non-zero after withdrawAll completes.
change_summary: Move the external call to msg.sender to occur before zeroing the caller's credit (introduces a reentrancy vulnerability that can change final credit/balance observed after withdrawAll).
